news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.21 (vs ₹0.15 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.21 (up from ₹0.15 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹30.4m (up 41% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.14m (up ₹1.87m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.8% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 33% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 8% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
